Requirements: R-19
Plan row: TS-15

Obligation: OB-15. Own workflows; residue stays (delete returns 500, carried to Gate A).

## Given

- Own workflow W named `TC015-<uid>`.
- Decision table with the expected code per input, stated from the pre-refactor contract before any call: P-unparseable 400; P-autonomous 403; P-valid 200 and persisted; P-multi (an input that violates the guardrail check and the MCP/autonomous check at once) returns the code of the check order the owner confirms.

## When

1. PUT each body to `/v1/workflows/{W}`.
2. GET W after each call.

## Then

1. P-unparseable: 400 "Workflow Configuration error"; stored config unchanged.
2. P-autonomous: 403; stored config unchanged.
3. P-valid: 200 and GET returns the new config with `id` equal to W's id (updated_config.id set).
4. P-multi: one stable code, equal to the expected value; a different code than before the refactor is a finding because the check order changed.

## Self-probe notes

- P-multi is the only input where the changed order (guardrail dry-run before MCP, autonomous, executor) is visible.
- Expected codes come from the register, not from the post-refactor behaviour.
- Then reads GET, independent of the PUT response.

## Obligation coverage

| obligation/part | oracle | boundary | Then/evidence | residual gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OB-15 same codes per invalid input | R-19 | API | Then 1, 2, 4 | P-multi expected code needs owner |
| OB-15 persists on success | R-19 | GET | Then 3 | none |
